chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'And remember Allah during fixed days.' He said: 'The Takbir (saying Allahu Akbar) is during the Days of Tashreeq for the Dhuhr prayer from the Day of Naḥr (10th Dhu al-Hijjah) until the Fajr prayer of the third day, and in the cities (Amṣār) there are ten prayers. When the people depart with the first departure, the people of the cities and whoever stayed in Mina and prayed Dhuhr and Asr there should keep silent (not recite the extra Takbir).'
ai.seo_question: When and how should Takbir be recited during the Days of Tashreeq after Eid al-Adha?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific timing and location for the ritual Takbir during the Days of Tashreeq, distinguishing between the continuous recitation in Mina after Dhuhr and Asr prayers and the ten prayers in other cities (Amṣār). It highlights the scholarly consensus on the practical application of Quranic verses regarding remembrance of Allah, linking the physical act of departure (Nafar) with the cessation of this specific devotional practice in Mina.
